title: Fix provision.sh env vars and ExecStart for serve orchestrator
description: Fix provision.sh orchestrator wiring: (1) Env var mismatch — script sets SANDBOX_HOST_ADDR but code expects ORCHESTRATOR_SANDBOX_HOST_ADDR. (2) ExecStart uses 'serve agent' but should use 'serve orchestrator' now that the command is implemented. (3) FLEXAGENT_ADVERTISE_ADDR is set but never consumed — remove or wire it. (4) Add auth token config. Also add compile-time interface assertions for Direct/Node/Cloud SandboxControl. Update README if needed.
